_comment: Example pointer for the Android bundled-library matcher. The canonical interface is the three subcommands of scripts/android_lib_match.py (fingerprint / build-corpus / match); this file just records a repeatable run. See docs/android_library_matching.md.
match_command: python3 scripts/android_lib_match.py match --candidate artifacts/android/app-release.apk --corpus corpus/okhttp.corpus.jsonl --out out/android_okhttp_match
